title: Orca servers
description: Tenant-wide Orca runtimes that agents reach with the orca CLI (--server <label>).
cliMissingHint: The orca CLI is not installed on the gateway host. Install it, then check again.
note: Servers are used by agents granted the orca CLI credential binary. A labeled CLI credential with the same label takes precedence.
emptyDescription: Run orca serve on a machine, copy the Pairing URL (orca://...), then add it here with a label.

form.createDesc: Register an Orca runtime by its pairing URL.
form.editDesc: Update the description or replace the pairing code.
form.label: Label
form.labelHint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (max 32). Cannot be changed later.
form.pairingKeep: Leave empty to keep the current code

errors.descriptionTooLong: Description must be 200 characters or fewer
errors.codeInvalid: Pairing code must start with orca://

deleteDialog.title: Delete Orca server
deleteDialog.description: Delete "{{label}}"? Agents will no longer be able to use it.

agents.title: Coding agents on {{label}}
agents.description: Agents that `orca ... --agent auto` can pick on this server, in priority order. Health comes from sign-in checks and launch failures.
agents.emptyHint: None configured: --agent auto is refused until agents are configured.

fields.descriptionPlaceholder: When to pick this agent (used by the router)

errors.keyInvalid: key must be 1-64 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'
errors.agentInvalid: agent id must be 1-64 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'
errors.modelInvalid: model may use letters, digits and . _ : / - and must not start with -
errors.fallbackRule: Only one fallback, and it must be enabled and not Planning
errors.planningLimit: Only one Planning agent is allowed
errors.descriptionTooLong: description must be {{maxLen}} characters or fewer
